title: manifest.jsonl — PRS Bill Track
description: One bill from the PRS Legislative Research Bill Track listing. PRS-derived records are internal-research-only and stamped source=prsindia.org for downstream segregation. Bill Track is a tracker, not an archive: a bill moves between statuses over time, so more than one row may exist per bill and the newest row is current.

bill_status.description: The bill's legislative status as PRS renders it (Passed, Lapsed, Withdrawn, Draft, Pending, In Committee, …). Read from the status span's TEXT: PRS emits class="status-pending" on every row regardless of the real status, so the class is decoration, not data. May be an empty string when PRS publishes no status for a bill.

status.description: Acquisition status. Bill Track is a listing surface; no document is downloaded, so records are metadata_only.
